ch3.title: Probability and Statistics
ch3.description: Foundational concepts in probability theory, statistical methods, distributions, and Bayes' rule — the mathematical bedrock for all machine learning.

ch8.title: Regressions
ch8.description: Linear and non-linear regression techniques including univariate, multivariate, polynomial, and regularized methods.

ch9.title: Classification Algorithms
ch9.description: Decision trees, SVM, k-NN, Naive Bayes, ensemble methods — algorithms for categorizing data into discrete classes.

ch10.title: Artificial Neural Networks
ch10.description: Perceptrons, backpropagation, gradient descent, LSTM, GRU, CNN, and RNN architectures for deep learning.

ch11.title: Self-supervised Deep Learning
ch11.description: Autoencoders, restricted Boltzmann machines, self-organizing maps, and denoising techniques for unsupervised representation learning.
